sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (deductible table implies up to ₹20L; exact SI range not explicitly stated)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals with no stated cap.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional 'Cashless Discount' add-on imposes 20% co-pay on reimbursement claims. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver, infectious conditions.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available as optional discount feature.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required; reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, joint arthroplasty, and 14 other listed conditions.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt CB: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 100% at 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. No inbuilt restoration.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 399+ procedures provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI but excludes asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, vector-borne diseases and several other chronic/common conditions. Must exceed 3 days.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Comfort/leisure treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell for haematological, HIFU, etc.) covered up to SI. CB and restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during treatment are covered as part of hospitalisation.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma etc., no maternity, no infertility/IVF, no external congenital anomalies, no refractive error <7.5D

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits (discount), Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
